title: When the Will Wakes Anew
author: August Dunmore
blurb: Zephyrine Almeida, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
